G4100.def: to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ)
G4100.kjv: believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with

G4102.def: persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself

G4105.def: to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue)
G4105.kjv: go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way

G4106.def: objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety

G4107.def: a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher

G4108.def: roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader;

G4109.def: a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively)

G4111.def: to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate

G4112.def: moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false)

G4113.def: a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square

G4118.def: the largest number or very large

G4119.def: more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion

G4121.def: to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound
G4121.kjv: abound, abundant, make to increase, have over

G4122.def: to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach
G4122.kjv: get an advantage, defraud, make a gain

G4126.derivation: probably a form of G4150 (πλύνω) (through the idea of plunging through the water);

G4128.def: a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace

G4130.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi);

G4133.def: moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet
G4133.kjv: but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than

G4134.def: replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete

G4135.def: to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish
G4135.kjv: most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of

G4137.def: to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.
G4137.kjv: accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply

G4138.def: repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period)
G4138.kjv: which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness

G4139.def: (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend)

G4140.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G4130 (πλήθω);

G4141.derivation: apparently another form of G4111 (πλάσσω) (through the idea of flattening out);
G4141.def: to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity)

G4142.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4143 (πλοῖον);

G4147.def: to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively)
G4147.kjv: be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich

G4149.def: wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment

G4150.derivation: a prolonged form of an obsolete (to "flow");

G4151.def: a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit

G4152.def: non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious

G4155.def: to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown)

G4156.def: throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled)

G4158.derivation: from G4228 (πούς) and another element of uncertain affinity;
G4158.def: a dress (G2066 (ἐσθής) implied) reaching the ankles

G4159.derivation: from the base of G4213 (πόσις) with enclitic adverb of origin;
G4159.def: from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause

G4160.derivation: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary;
G4160.def: to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct)

G4165.def: to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser)

G4168.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4167 (ποίμνη);

G4169.derivation: from the base of G4226 (ποῦ) and G3634 (οἷος);
G4169.def: individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one

G4170.def: to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or figuratively)

G4171.def: warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series)

G4172.derivation: probably from the same as G4171 (πόλεμος), or perhaps from G4183 (πολύς);
G4172.def: a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size)

G4176.derivation: middle voice of a derivative of G4177 (πολίτης);

G4179.derivation: from G4183 (πολύς) and probably a derivative of G4120 (πλέκω);
G4179.def: manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more

G4180.derivation: from a compound of G4183 (πολύς) and G3056 (λόγος);

G4181.derivation: adverb from a compound of G4183 (πολύς) and G3313 (μέρος);
G4181.def: in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal)

G4183.derivation: including the forms from the alternate ;
G4183.def: (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely
G4183.kjv: abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly

G4185.kjv: costly, very precious, of great price

G4187.derivation: adverb from a compound of G4183 (πολύς) and G5158 (τρόπος);
G4187.def: in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form

G4189.def: depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins

G4190.def: hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from G2556 (κακός), which refers rather to essential character, as well as from G4550 (σαπρός), which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners
G4190.kjv: bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness)

G4193.def: a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus

G4195.def: a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor

G4197.def: travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career

G4198.derivation: middle voice from a derivative of the same as G3984 (πεῖρα);
G4198.def: to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.);
G4198.kjv: --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk
